verdict.rationale: Synctera is an API-first banking platform with a published OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt index of its docs. It offers clean programmatic access to customers and accounts, plus webhooks that push event updates, so an agent would not need to scrape a dashboard. However, the evidence never shows read endpoints for transaction history, pending activity, or statements and documents, and there is no MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit transaction/pending-activity read APIs, document/statement retrieval, an official MCP surface, independent hands-on corroboration.
